assessments.reasoning: The Lua 5.4 metatable discussion distinguishes the string key __add from the callable stored under it. The addition entry confirms the mapping to the + operator and specifies when and where Lua looks up the callable.

challenge.method: Check an addition with two numbers and one with a numeric first operand and a nonnumeric second operand.
challenge.results: Two numbers do not trigger this fallback. With a nonnumeric operand, lookup starts at the first operand even if it is numeric, then proceeds to the second if needed. The additional span establishes this lookup boundary.

limitations: The key describes the addition event. Ordinary numeric addition and operand lookup follow their own documented conditions.
